notes:
Summary: AuraBound is a mid-market sales enablement SaaS (buyer lifecycle assistant for SDRs/AEs). Product team evaluating Redwood Hosted API as first step; goal is low-latency streaming chat agents that can call customer tools (CRM update, send email, create calendar invite). Primary ask: consistent streaming latency for live agent handoff and sub-200ms token stream for p50; p95 target <= 400-500ms. Cost sensitivity moderate - they expect to optimize after POC but want clear cost/perf tradeoffs.

Key quotes: 'We need streaming that feels live - delays destroy conversation flow.' - Head of Product. 'Tool calling needs to be safe and auditable: who triggered what, and rollback.' - Security lead.

Model preferences: prefer Redwood-verified Llama-family quantized variants for cost control, but open to managed larger model if latency + cost acceptable. Want fallback routing: cheaper quantized model for bulk outbound, higher-fidelity model for complex replies.

Operational constraints: want VPC peering for Dedicated later; initial POC will run on hosted with strict egress rules. Compliance: require SSO/SAML, KMS integration, retention controls, audit logs for tool calls. Data residency: US-only for now.

POC scope: 3 flows - (1) outbound SDR chat with CRM writeback, (2) inbound lead triage with calendar scheduling, (3) live agent handoff with streaming + function/tool call. Metrics: p50/p95 token latency, end-to-end turn latency, token cost, success rate of tool calls, audit log completeness.
